Palak Wadhwa 
Delhi, India 110084 

+91-9315109020  wpalak16@gmail.com https://www.linkedin.com/in/palak-wadhwa-729622225

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 

Proactive PMO Analyst at Deloitte USI with 2+ years of experience in project coordination and stakeholder 
engagement and functional leadership. Proven track record of monitoring project performance, managing RAID logs, 
and ensuring alignment with control frameworks and strategic objectives. Currently serving as a Functional 
Lead, overseeing project delivery and driving operational efficiency. 

EDUCATION 

Jagan Institute of Management Studies Delhi, India 

BCA: Information Technology 09/2023 

EXPERIENCE 

   Deloitte USI Delhi, India 

PMO Analyst 01/2024 – Current 

• Analysed business requirements and translated them into functional specifications, managed multiple client 
requests simultaneously ensuring smooth operations, timely SLA completion, and alignment with
organizational objectives.

• Led end-to-end onboarding and offboarding of project resources within defined SLAs, ensuring timely 
workforce availability and smooth transition across engagement. 

• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to identify process improvements, optimize deliverables, and 
enhanced project efficiency.

• Led Daily stand-up calls, Client update meetings, presenting progress, milestone achieved, and action plans for 
challenges. 

• Drive continuous improvement of project management practices by identifying areas of enhancement and 
implementing effective change management strategies.

• Documented and explained project tools, processes and workflows to internal and external stakeholders. 

• Prepared various trackers including Leave trackers and comprehensive project documentation and reports, 
ensuring accuracy and compliance with established governance standards.

Island Peak Cloud Infotech Pvt. Ltd. Remote 

HR Intern 03/2023 – 12/2023 

• Led and supported the end-to-end recruitment cycle, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, and
onboarding of candidates.

• Utilized Asana for task and workflow management, ensuring timely tracking and completion of all HR and
recruitment activities.

Viral Fission Remote 

Campus Ambassador 02/2021 – 12/2023 

• Designed and executed campus engagement strategies to enhance student participation in promotional events, resulting in
increased outreach and visibility.

• Organized and facilitated interactive workshops and presentations to educate students on the brand’s
offerings and values.

SKILLS 

Analysis & Management: Project analysis, Project documentation, Stakeholder engagement, Performance metrics, 
Assets and Demand Management 

Tools & Platforms: Power BI, MS Office Suite, Jira, SharePoint, Service Now, ReviewNow, OrgScanner, Asana, SmartSupport, 
Gen AI. 
Methodologies & Languages: Agile, Python 

CERTIFICATIONS 

Project management 

LANGUAGES & INTERESTS 

Languages: English (Bilingual/C2), Hindi (Bilingual/C2) 
Interests: Singing, Travelling, Dancing. 

mailto:%20wpalak16@gmail.com
https://www.linkedin.com/in/palak-wadhwa-729622225
